assets.name: Austin
assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied original TerraFirma billboard into a text-free, distinctive city illustration background. Preserve the original chrome futuristic Operator family and intricate ink-drawn comic / industrial-futurist visual language. Bring back personality and place while leaving a clean central type field. Wide 3:1 landscape canvas. Flat bone #EFEBE4 ground, dark navy #14182A linework, burnt-orange Mars, chrome highlights. Operator fills left 22% from shoulders up, expressive three-quarter attitude and tailored distinctive clothing, complete head and accessories inside left 23%. Small orange Mars disc behind operator. Rightmost 24% contains a recognizable but restrained city skyline in fine ink: just 2 or 3 defining landmarks, not a dense panorama. An excavator occupies lower right, with ONE clearly visible upright rocket slightly behind it at far right, about 20% canvas height, clean white/chrome body with a small orange exhaust or launch glow. The rocket must be visible at thumbnail size, not a tiny needle. A few restrained engineering grid lines along lower-right edge. Leave x=25% through x=73%, y=8% through y=92%, clean uninterrupted bone negative space for type overlay. NO lines, buildings, haze, vehicles, props, or text across that central field. City skyline belongs to the right zone only; height can rise behind the excavator. Character and city should feel unique but part of the same campaign. A little colored neon rim light on chrome and skyline adds atmosphere. No heavy vignette, no full dark background, no clutter. Remove ALL original words, logos, labels, typography, neon letterforms, patches, and badges. No new text of any kind. Avoid literal costume stereotypes or tourist souvenirs. Preserve a confident, playful, future-building spirit. This is a background only; crisp neon headlines will be composited separately.
CITY-SPECIFIC ART DIRECTION: Confident Texas cowboy Operator: broad weathered cowboy hat, loose bandana, western-cut utility vest, relaxed three-quarter chin-up pose. Preserve the original Austin character charisma. Warm amber neon reflections. Skyline: the Frost Bank Tower and slender downtown Austin towers; a restrained Congress Avenue bridge line.
